prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent PNG sprite atlas for an offline fantasy RPG. Exactly 4 columns by 2 rows, 8 full-body sprites of ONE SAME adult chibi hero, 3 heads tall, handsome/beautiful anime face, richly detailed chunky square pixel-art clusters and dark pixel outlines, matching polished charming retro JRPG chibi sprites. Every cell same scale and grounded feet aligned, generous 10% transparent padding; no lines, labels, text, backgrounds, floor, framing or watermark. All characters face screen RIGHT in three-quarter view. Cell order left-to-right row1: relaxed idle eyes open; SAME idle blinking eyes closed; attack1; attack2. Row2: attack3; attack4; critical charge low prepared stance; critical impact powerful lunging strike with tiny contained magical burst. Four ordinary attacks genuinely different full-body stances, recognizable consistent costume/hair/face/weapon in all8 cells. Weapons and effects stay entirely inside their own cells, never cross boundaries. Background must be genuinely alpha-transparent, no glow/vignette/checkerboard drawn. Asset design: Adult female monk: long navy braid, teal eyes, pale blue martial jacket and white trousers, jade dragon clasp, turquoise jade gauntlets. Unarmed martial artist with enchanted gauntlets, never a staff or sword. Attacks straight punch, low palm strike, rising uppercut, side kick; critical charge low horse stance fists drawn to waist, critical impact powerful double palm thrust with a small chi burst. Tasteful complete fantasy clothing, charming heroic personality. Exact4x2 atlas landscape1536x1024.
CRITICAL LAYOUT OVERRIDE: Each sprite fits entirely inside the central60percent of its own exact384x512cell, leaving20percent completely empty alpha-transparent margin on ALL four sides of everycell. Keep 4columns×2rows exact. Fist/palm magicalFX tiny and contained within the same central60percent, no wide rays, no particle bridges, no contact between anycells. All8 sprites same chibi scale and fullbody feet visible. Transparentemptyspace must separate all8 main character components. Preserve all costume features and distinctposes.
visualReview: 8 distinct cells with idle/blink, punch/palm/kick/charge/critical; consistent costume and hairstyle
